ValidationRule.description: CHAT-245: Immunized T_AUTH CDE_IMM Y Required if CDE_REL_PROVR is 'Out of Home, Non-Relative'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Permission.System_Administrator),NOT(CONTAINS( LEFT( OwnerId , 15) ,LEFT($Label.ByPass_Auth_validation, 15))), ISBLANK(TEXT( CDE_IMM__c )) , ISPICKVAL( CDE_REL_PROVR__c , '1') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A value is required for Immunized if Provider Location / Relation to Child is selected as 'Out of home non-relative'
